technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: System boundary of this study is cradle to gate with options, modules C1–C4, module D and with optional modules (A1–A3 + C + D and A4-A5, B2). According to the product category rules (PCR), mounting structures like inverter, wiring, etc., are not considered in this study.
technology.technologicalApplicability: The PV module can be installed both as rooftop and ground-mounted type.
